description: This file defines signing policies for Kubernetes certificate authorities, including the PermissiveSigningPolicy implementation, handling certificate template modifications, key usages, and expiration validation.

classes.name: PermissiveSigningPolicy
classes.description: Implements a signing policy that forwards SANs, sets key usages, and manages certificate expiration.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Modifies an x509.Certificate template according to the policy, setting NotBefore, NotAfter, key usages, and extensions.
